name: web
description: TimetableKit public playground and documentation site.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @ndycode/timetablekit build && corepack pnpm --filter @ndycode/timetablekit-provider-tesseract build && corepack pnpm --filter @ndycode/timetablekit-provider-pdfjs build && next build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @ndycode/timetablekit build && corepack pnpm --filter @ndycode/timetablekit-provider-tesseract build && corepack pnpm --filter @ndycode/timetablekit-provider-pdfjs build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: pnpm exec vitest run lib/input-boundary.test.ts app/api/parse/route.unit.test.ts --config ../../vitest.config.ts
